data.title: Doug Bergeron Files Preliminary Proxy Statement for Ethan Allen’s 2026 Annual Meeting
data.description: A shareholder of Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. named Doug Bergeron, who owns 5.2% of the company's common stock along with affiliates, filed a preliminary proxy statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. This filing is in relation to his nomination of five qualified candidates for Ethan Allen's Board of Directors. The shareholder, based in Park City, Utah, is seeking to bring fresh perspectives to the company's leadership. The news was announced without disclosing the source of information.

data.title: indie Announces New Employee Inducement Grants
data.description: Aliso Viejo, California - indie Semiconductor (Nasdaq: INDI), a pioneer in automotive solutions, disclosed the issuance of equity awards, known as the "Inducement Grants," from its 2023 Inducement Incentive Plan to fresh recruits. These grants were sanctioned by indie Semiconductor's Board of Directors' Compensation Committee. Full details about the equity awards are available on the company's investor relations webpage.

data.title: Kidney Patients Engage Congress During Summer Recess
data.description: The American Association of Kidney Patients (AAKP) praised the enactment of job protections for organ donors and highlighted ongoing challenges with regulatory red tape from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). AAKP, the leading non-partisan kidney patient advocacy group in the country, hosted its second yearly event, emphasizing the need for better policies to support organ donors.

data.title: Intellia Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: In Cambridge, Massachusetts, on September 4, 2026, Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. revealed that they provided inducement grants to 41 new employees on September 1, 2026. This program falls under Intellia's 2024 Inducement Plan and serves as a significant incentive for joining the company. Intellia is a prominent biopharmaceutical firm that specializes in transforming medicine through CRISPR gene editing and other key technologies. The company is listed on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol NTLA, and these inducement grants highlight their commitment to attracting top talent in the industry.

data.title: SOS Ltd. Announces Receipt of NYSE Non-compliance Letter Regarding Class A Ordinary Shares Trading Price
data.description: In Qingdao, China, on September 4, 2026, SOS Limited (NYSE: SOS) disclosed receiving a letter from the New York Stock Exchange on August 7, 2026. The NYSE informed SOS that it is not meeting compliance requirements because the trading price of SOS's Class A ordinary shares is below the standard.

data.title: Avalo Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grants to New Employees Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: Avalo Therapeutics, Inc., based in Wayne, Pennsylvania, disclosed on September 4, 2026, that they granted inducement equity awards to six new employees. The Compensation Committee of Avalo's Board of Directors sanctioned the allotment of nonstatutory stock options for acquiring a total of 78,000 common shares (referred to as "Options"). These awards were considered significant inducements for the new employees joining the company. Avalo specializes in developing treatments that target the IL-1β pathway for immune-mediated inflammatory conditions. The company's stock is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol AVTX.

data.title: Dauch to Present at the 2026 Jefferies Global Industrials Conference on September 10
data.description: A leading company, Dauch Corporation (NYSE: DCH, LSE: DCH), is set to take part in the upcoming 2026 Jefferies Global Industrials Conference on September 10. The company will engage in a fireside chat presentation at 11:30 a.m. ET during the event. This participation aims to facilitate discussions on key industrial matters and strategies.

data.title: Bank of America Announces Redemptions of CAD425,000,000 Floating Rate Senior Notes and CAD1,000,000,000 1.978% Fixed/Floating Rate Senior Notes, Due September 2027
data.description: Bank of America Corporation made public its decision today in Charlotte, North Carolina, to repurchase all CAD425,000,000 principal amount of its Floating Rate Senior Notes scheduled to mature in September 2027. The redemption date is set for September 15, 2026. The specific notes have the CUSIP No. 060505FY5 and ISIN CA060505FY50.

data.title: Hyperscale Data Announces a Special Dividend of Class B Common Stock
data.description: Hyperscale Data, Inc. (NYSE American: GPUS) based in Las Vegas, revealed its decision to declare a special dividend for all Common and Preferred Stockholders. The diversified holding company is offering a one-time dividend to its shareholders. The announcement was made on September 4, 2026. This move is anticipated to significantly benefit all stakeholders invested in the company.

data.title: BTC Digital Ltd. Regains Compliance with Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Requirement Following Prior Deficiency Notice
data.description: Today, September 4, 2026, BTC Digital Ltd. (NASDAQ: BTCT), a digital computing infrastructure company listed on Nasdaq, disclosed that it received written notification from The Nasdaq Stock Exchange regarding its listing qualifications.
